entities.summary: Jasper Johns is an American painter, sculptor, draftsman, and printmaker. Considered a central figure in the development of American postwar art, he has been variously associated with abstract expressionism, Neo-Dada, and pop art movements. Jasper Johns was a authors & novelists from Augusta (b. 1930-05-15, Augusta). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
